items.html: And this continued until Abraham came and brought her down one firmament, which is the aspect of the Hesed within her, which spread downward, as is known — for Abraham was a man of Hesed. And so did the rest, until Moses, when also her Malchut spread, and her ten Sefirot spread in the aspect of back to back, below the chest; and still the light of his five [Sefirot] does not illuminate in her. And all this on weekdays, as above.
